_comment: Generic template for settings.json:autoMode.environment (IMP-219, vault-by-design). This block is a LIVE-INSTALL-ONLY key — it lives only in ~/.claude/settings.json and never migrates into the workshop (see HAUS_ONLY_KEYS_JSON in scripts/deploy-to-live.sh). Replace the placeholders in [square brackets] with your own details, remove this comment key, and carry over only the 'environment' array into your own autoMode object.
environment: **Repository visibility**: [public|private] — `[host]/[account]/[repo]` (confirmed via gh; note any rulesets or protected-branch entries)
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Default / protected branches**: [describe branch protection, if any]
**Source control**: The trusted repo (`[host]/[account]/[repo]`) and its `origin` remote only

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: any file or store holding personal data, confidential business data, credentials, regulated data, or similarly sensitive material; preserve exact handles when known and share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar

**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment (hyphen/underscore/dot-delimited — e.g. matches `prod-db`, not `producer`)
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Primary use of Claude Code**: [describe your primary use case here — e.g. software development, framework maintenance, writing, research]

**Trusted repo**: `~/.claude` (the Claude Code installation), `$CLAUDE_BAUHOF_ROOT` (this framework's working copy), and the local clone of the public framework mirror — replace with YOUR OWN trusted repo(s)/remote(s) if this entry describes a different project

routine under `~/.claude/` prefix: this machine's Claude Code configuration follows the workshop/live-install split described in `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` — `$CLAUDE_BAUHOF_ROOT` is the working copy, `~/.claude` is the installation that actually gets read
